name: megascenes-pet-portrait
description: Turn a photo of your pet from your MegaScenes library into a portrait, regal, watercolor, oil painting or cartoon, keeping its breed and markings.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a photo of your dog, cat or any animal from your MegaScenes library and choose the style: a regal portrait, a Renaissance oil painting, a watercolor, a cartoon or a fun outfit. You get a portrait that keeps its breed, colors and markings.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the portrait needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The portrait opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the photo.

For gifts, prints, memorials and pet profiles.

Limitations: one pet photo per portrait, already in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Styles are described in general terms, not by a studio or brand name. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Turn your pet into a portrait in any style
Return the portrait in the chat
defaultPrompt: Turn my latest MegaScenes photo of my dog into a regal portrait
Make a watercolor portrait of my cat from my library
Paint my pet as a Renaissance noble in an oil painting

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Turn the photo of my golden retriever in my MegaScenes library into a regal portrait. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one pet portrait with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a pet portrait here?
positive.expected_behavior: The pet portrait models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Turn the photo of my golden retriever in my MegaScenes library into a regal portrait. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my pet portrait on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my pet portrait to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
